_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::ehl#3. The rule (verify the setup with alpha = 0, then ramp) holds and the window is measured here on upstream ehl_bearing_barus.4C.yaml, whose MAT_lubrication_law_barus PreVisCoeff is 0.0112: alpha = 0 and alpha = 3x both complete both time steps and reach the result-test manager, while alpha = 10x is killed by SIGFPE with no 4C error line and no 'Checking results of' section at all (DEAD_REACHED_RESULT_TEST=0). The entry's phrase 'Newton diverges in step 1' is not reportable — the process dies inside the element evaluation after two Newton rows, so MPI_Abort never runs and 4C says nothing. The alpha = 0 arm's result tests report WRONG because the deck's references belong to the piezoviscous law, which is what an alpha = 0 sanity run is for. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).
expect_in_output: Result check failed with 4 errors out of 4 tests

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the dead arm: give it the upstream alpha. It then completes, EXIT_DEAD stops being 136, DEAD_REACHED_RESULT_TEST becomes 1 (a forbidden token) and the fixture must go red.
break the cold-start half: give the alpha = 0 sanity arm the killing alpha instead. ALPHA0_REACHED_RESULT_TEST drops to 0 (a forbidden token), so the fixture must go red.
